benefits.name: 25% Back on United Inflight and Club Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on food, beverages, and Wi-Fi purchased aboard United-operated flights, and on United Club premium drinks.
benefits.terms: Rebate is 25% of each qualifying purchase, with no fixed annual dollar cap stated. Applies to United inflight food, beverages, and Wi-Fi, and United Club premium drinks.

benefits.name: Two Free Checked Bags After $10,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: Two free checked bags on United-operated flights after spending $10,000 on purchases in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $10,000 in purchases in a calendar year. Not automatic on card approval.

benefits.name: Award Flight Savings After $10,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: Save 10% or more on United award flights booked with miles after spending $10,000 on purchases in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $10,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars when the rental is paid for with the card.
benefits.terms: Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft, up to $500 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: 2x miles from the card on United purchases. On eligible United flights this stacks with 3x base MileagePlus miles for 5x total.
Local transit and commuting, including rideshare, taxis, tolls, trains, and buses.
